data.title: Anwendungsarchitekt - Full-Stack Java/Spring, React, K8s (m/w/d)
data.description:
Du wirst Teil eines KI-nativen Start-ups in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase, dessen Produkt seinen Product-Market-Fit bereits unter Beweis gestellt hat. Wir entwickeln modernste KI-Lösungen für Governance, Risikomanagement und Compliance (GRC) für Unternehmen weltweit.

Unsere Kunden sind Auditoren, Risikomanager und Compliance-Teams. Deshalb sind gründliche Evaluierung, Auditierbarkeit und die Vorbereitung auf die Anforderungen der EU-KI-Verordnung für uns keine nachträglichen Ergänzungen, sondern feste Produktanforderungen.

Aufgaben

Als Anwendungsarchitekt (m/w/d) gehörst du zu unseren ersten Senior-Entwicklern in Vollzeit und arbeitest eng mit unserem Mitgründer und CTO zusammen. Du verantwortest die Backend-Architektur und hilfst dem Team, Qualität und Entwicklungsgeschwindigkeit mit dem Wachstum zu steigern.

In den ersten 6–12 Monaten wirst du:

  • eine klare Zielarchitektur und eine solide Dokumentationsgrundlage mit arc42 etablieren;
  • das zentrale Domänenmodell anhand von DDD-Prinzipien präzisieren und im Team vermitteln;
  • einen KI-getriebenen Entwicklungsprozess einführen und standardisieren – von der Feature-Spezifikation bis zur Bereitstellung in der Produktionsumgebung;
  • die Entwicklungspraxis durch Coaching, Pair Programming und Feedbackschleifen stärken, insbesondere für Junior-Entwickler;
  • die Zuverlässigkeit und Softwareauslieferung durch bessere CI/CD-Prozesse, Testautomatisierung und eine sauber gepflegte Infrastruktur verbessern.

Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Gemeinsam mit dem Team überzeugende Lösungen für neuartige Problemstellungen in einer AI-first-Architektur entwickeln.
  • Einen DevOps-orientierten Ansatz über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg vorantreiben: von der Spezifikation über die Entwicklung bis zur Auslieferung – inspiriert vom DevOps Handbook.
  • Ansätze vorschlagen und umsetzen, die die Softwareauslieferung schneller und zuverlässiger machen, etwa durch einen besseren Arbeitsfluss, kürzere Feedbackschleifen und eine schnellere Wiederherstellung nach Störungen.
  • Systemübergreifendes Monitoring und Observability aufbauen und weiterentwickeln – einschließlich Metriken, Logs, Traces und Alarmierung –, damit wir Probleme frühzeitig erkennen und aus dem Produktivbetrieb lernen.
  • Junior-Entwickler coachen und gemeinsam mit ihnen bewährte Entwicklungs-, Design- und Architekturpraktiken anwenden.
  • Zusammen mit dem Team einen KI-getriebenen Entwicklungsprozess gestalten, von der Feature-Spezifikation bis zur Bereitstellung in der Produktionsumgebung.
  • Die Backend-Architektur mit dem arc42-Framework planen und dokumentieren.
  • Das Domänenmodell anhand von DDD-Prinzipien erweitern und verständlich vermitteln.
  • Die Anwendungsinfrastruktur auf Azure mit Pulumi verwalten und ausbauen.

Qualifikation

Unverzichtbare Voraussetzungen

  • Erfahrung mit dem arc42-Framework (ISAQB) und C4.
  • Erfahrung darin, Entwicklungsteams zu führen und zu befähigen.
  • Tiefgehende Erfahrung mit Java Spring Boot (MVC, JPA, Security).
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Entwurfsmustern und Domain-Driven Design.
  • Hervorragende Codequalität auf Basis von Clean-Code- und SOLID-Prinzipien.
  • Umfassende Erfahrung mit TDD und BDD.
  • Erfahrung in der Full-Stack-Webentwicklung mit React und Angular.

Darüber hinaus überzeugst du mit …

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code auf Azure oder AWS mit Pulumi.
  • Einer ausgeprägten DevOps-Mentalität – das DevOps Handbook ist deine Bibel – und Erfahrung beim Aufbau von:
  • zuverlässigen CI/CD-Pipelines und Release-Prozessen;
  • produktionsreifem Monitoring und Observability sowie Verfahren zur Reaktion auf Betriebsstörungen;
  • kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen, etwa durch die Nachbereitung von Störungen, das Lernen aus dem Betrieb und die Priorisierung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit.
  • Erfahrung mit Claude Code oder vergleichbaren KI-gestützten Entwicklungsworkflows.
  • IntelliJ-Kenntnissen auf Power-User-Niveau.

Benefits

  • Eigenverantwortliche, praktische Arbeit an einem echten KI-Produkt, das bereits von Unternehmenskunden eingesetzt wird.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründungsteam vom ersten Tag an.
  • Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Standort im Münchner Norden, mindestens ein Tag pro Woche im Büro, ansonsten flexibel. Bei besonders guter Passung sind wir auch offen für qualifizierte Kandidaten aus anderen Teilen der EU. Die Einarbeitung findet vor Ort im Büro statt.
  • Eine steile Lernkurve an der Schnittstelle von LLM-Engineering, GRC im Unternehmensumfeld und dem operativen Aufbau eines Start-ups.
  • Die Möglichkeit, unser KI-Team mitzugestalten, während wir wachsen.

Auxilius ai entwickelt KI-gestützte GRC-Lösungen für Unternehmen. Wir befinden uns in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase, wachsen schnell und können bereits auf echte Kunden bauen. Unser Technologie-Stack umfasst Java und Spring Boot, Angular, Kubernetes auf Azure sowie LLMs von OpenAI und Anthropic.

Influencer Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
data.description:
Visca Marketing | Vollzeit | Remote-first | Mid–Senior Level

Wir glauben, dass Influencer Marketing mehr ist als Reichweite – nämlich ein echter Performance- und Wachstumskanal.

Gemeinsam treiben wir genau das voran: Kampagnen datengetrieben skalieren und auf ROAS, Umsatz und Impact optimieren.Bei VISCA gestaltest du aktiv mit, wie wir Influencer Marketing als skalierbaren Wachstumstreiber etablieren.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die End-to-End Verantwortung für Influencer Performance Kampagnen – von der Creator-Auswahl bis zur Budgetsteuerung, Optimierung und Skalierung

  • Du sorgst für den Kampagnenerfolg durch gezieltes Scouting, passgenaue Buchung und starke Preisverhandlungen mit Creatorn

  • Du analysierst zentrale Performance KPIs (ROAS, Revenue, CPA, Neukunden) und leitest konkrete Optimierungen ab
  • Du testest kontinuierlich neue Creator, Formate und Plattformen, um Kampagnen weiter zu skalieren
  • Du unterstützt den Aufbau eines langfristigen Creator Pools und entwickelst unsere Influencer-Datenbank weiter

Qualifikation

  • Du konntest bereits wertvolle Erfahrung im Influencer Performance Marketing (Agentur oder Brand) sammeln und hast Kampagnen erfolgreich umgesetzt

  • Dein analytisches Verständnis setzt du gezielt ein, um Performance KPIs wie ROAS, Umsatz und CPA zu steuern und datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen

  • Du bist sicher in der Budgetsteuerung und nutzt diese gezielt zur Performance-Optimierung und Skalierung

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Kampagnen im Multi-Brand-Setup den Überblick

  • Dein Verhandlungsgeschick setzt du zielorientiert bei der Auswahl und Zusammenarbeit mit Influencern ein

  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Influencer-Marketing-Tools (z. B. Linkster, Storyclash oder vergleichbar)Dein Profil wird durch sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse abgerundet

  • Flexibles Arbeiten & Vertrauen: Remote-first Setup mit hoher Eigenverantwortung – arbeite so, wie du am produktivsten bist

  • Mehr als eine Brand: Abwechslung und Vielfalt sind bei uns garantiert – durch unser Agentur-Setup mit mehreren Brands entwickelst du dich kontinuierlich weiter

  • Wachstum & Mitgestaltung: Du baust VISCA aktiv mit auf, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst dich mit dem Wachstum in die Rolle, die zu dir passt

  • Sichtbarer Impact: Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss – du siehst konkret, wie deine Kampagnen Performance treiben und Ergebnisse liefern

Wir berichten direkt an den CFO und bündeln Themen wie Internes Kontrollsystem, operationelle Risiken, Incidents, Drittparteien sowie wiederkehrende Bestätigungen der Fachbereiche an einem zentralen Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team und den Fachbereichen zusammen, übernimmst früh Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen strukturiert erfasst, Aufgaben sauber verteilt und Statusdaten ohne manuelles Nachfassen ins Reporting fließen.


Das erwartet Dich:

  • Workflows konfigurieren: Du entwickelst Workflows in unserer GRC-Software OneTrust, von der Analyse des Ablaufs bis zur fertigen Konfiguration mit Datenfeldern, Statuslogiken, Verantwortlichkeiten, Eskalationen und automatischen Benachrichtigungen.
  • Systeme integrieren: Du verbindest OneTrust über Schnittstellen und moderne Workflow-Tools mit weiteren Systemen bei auxmoney, zum Beispiel Slack, SharePoint oder Outlook, damit Fachbereiche Statusupdates dort liefern können, wo sie ohnehin arbeiten.
  • Automatisierungen aufbauen: Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Handgriffe und ersetzt sie durch Automatisierungen, die Informationen anfordern, Aufgaben verteilen, Fristen überwachen und Folgeaktivitäten auslösen, etwa bei regelmäßigen Bestätigungen der Fachbereiche oder bei der Überprüfung unserer Dienstleister.
  • KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du baust mit unseren KI-Bausteinen konkrete Lösungen für das Risikomanagement, zum Beispiel zur Strukturierung von Informationen, zur Vorbereitung von Bewertungen, zum Erkennen fehlender Angaben oder zum Zusammenfassen von Berichten, und achtest dabei auf Nachvollziehbarkeit und Qualität.

  • Reporting verbessern: Du sorgst dafür, dass Informationen vollständig und strukturiert erfasst werden, und überführst Statusdaten automatisiert in klare Übersichten für Management und Board.
  • Flexibel arbeiten: Du arbeitest flexibel aus dem Homeoffice. Wenn Du in der Nähe von Düsseldorf studierst, triffst Du Dein Team einmal pro Woche im Büro, ansonsten sehen wir uns regelmäßig digital und zu gemeinsamen Team-Tagen vor Ort.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer – IT Risk & Pricing (m/f/d)
data.description:
Your new team:

As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) at auxmoney, you’ll join our IT Risk & Pricing team, where we build backend systems and services that support risk decisioning, pricing, and data-driven product logic. The work is backend-heavy, involving complex technical problem-solving and close integration with data/analytics workflows. 
 
In this role, you’ll design and deliver impactful features, help evolve a scalable, resilient architecture, and take end-to-end ownership from concept through production. You’ll work closely with analysts/data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to ship high-quality solutions and continuously improve our engineering standards. If you are passionate about writing clean, maintainable code, solving complex technical challenges, and building software that delivers real value, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.


What you can expect:

  • Architecture & System Design: Identify and address architectural limitations, make pragmatic trade-offs, and help evolve systems toward scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Technical Leadership: Act as a trusted technical expert by promoting engineering best practices, facilitating technical discussions, and helping teams align on high-quality solutions.
  • Engineering Quality: Build solutions that are secure, scalable, extensible, and cost-efficient while maintaining high coding and documentation standards.
  • Execution & Delivery: Break down complex initiatives into manageable workstreams and deliver incremental value through iterative development.
  • Impact & Knowledge Sharing: Champion engineering excellence, share knowledge proactively, and support the professional growth of colleagues.
  • Collaboration & Problem Solving: Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders, actively contribute to design reviews, and address root causes of recurring technical challenges.
  • Ownership & Mentorship: Take responsibility for challenging projects and guide team members through technical mentoring and hands-on support.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset: Balance short-term delivery with long-term system sustainability and continuously look for opportunities to improve technology, processes, and team effectiveness.


Your profile

  • Backend Engineering Expertise: Several years of hands-on backend development experience with preferably strong proficiency in PHP, particularly using the Symfony framework and Python.
  • System & API Development: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust backend systems in production environments, including strong expertise in developing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • SQL Expertise: Hands-on SQL experience in application development, with strong proficiency in relational data modelling (table design, keys, and constraints) and writing complex, performant queries to support business features.
  • Cloud & DevOps Practices: Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is highly valued.
  • Event-Driven Architecture (Bonus): Familiarity with Kafka or similar event-driven messaging systems is considered a strong advantage.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Solid understanding of automated testing strategies, including unit and integration testing, with a focus on delivering reliable and high-quality software aligned with overall quality standards.
  • Product-Oriented Mindset: A strong focus on building solutions that deliver measurable value for users and business outcomes.
  • Team & Communication Skills: Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a supportive engineering culture.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: A proactive approach to implementing security best practices and ensuring compliance throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Language Skills: Fluent written and spoken English.


What we offer:

  • Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.
  • Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace.

  • Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed.
  • Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility.

For us as an employer, equal opportunities and diversity are especially important. Therefore, we welcome applications from mothers, fathers, people with disabilities and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. data.title: Training Specialist (m/f/d)
data.description:
Why should you join?

DocuWare stands for globally distributed, international teams and an open corporate culture that invites you to help shape it. Mobile Work and flexible working hours are part of our everyday life. Would you like to be part of an innovative company whose solutions are digitizing everyday work in a wide range of industries? In that case, we are happy to welcome you to the team.


Your Responsibilities

As a Training Specialist (m/f/d), you will empower our sales teams and partners to successfully sell, confidently demonstrate, and effectively implement DocuWare solutions for our customers. Leveraging your expertise, you will develop modern learning programs, deliver engaging training experiences, and play a key role in strengthening the success of our sales and partner organizations.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • You plan, coordinate, and deliver training programs for our sales teams and partners, ensuring an engaging and effective learning experience.
  • You design modern training concepts and define appropriate methodologies and instructional approaches to enable sustainable knowledge transfer.
  • You create, update, and continuously improve training programs based on business requirements and learning objectives.
  • You develop and maintain high-quality training materials, including course content, e-learning modules, assessments, and certification programs.
  • You collaborate closely with sales teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to align training content with business needs and audience expectations.
  • You support the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of product demonstrations for our sales teams and partners.
  • You act as a subject matter expert in meetings, workshops, and events, providing guidance on sales and product-related topics.
  • You identify opportunities to improve existing training offerings and actively contribute new ideas to enhance our learning and enablement programs.


What you need to succeed

  • You hold a degree in Education, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or have gained equivalent qualifications through relevant professional experience.
  • You are skilled at adapting to different audiences and levels of expertise, delivering content in a clear, practical, and impactful way.
  • You have ideally gained experience in training, enablement, learning & development, or technical support.
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and modern presentation and collaboration tools, and you are confident delivering both in-person and virtual training sessions.
  • You have a solid understanding of the customer journey, sales processes, and common sales methodologies such as SPIN.
  • You possess a strong understanding of business processes and their translation into digital workflows, and you can quickly familiarize yourself with complex software solutions.
  • Experience with DocuWare or other document management solutions is an advantage.
  • You are fluent in both German and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • You work independently, thrive in international team environments, and bring strong communication, networking, and interpersonal skills.


What we can offer

There are many great reasons to join DocuWare - our company culture is only one of them.
 As part of the DocuWare team, you will benefit from many advantages:

  • Globally distributed, international teams: You will find our teams working in Germering, New York, Sofia or other worldwide locations.
  • Flexible work location and hours: You work hybrid - on the road or in our modern office - and you have the flexibility to arrange your own working hours.
  • Individual support: After an intensive induction, you will receive regular training tailored to your needs (e.g. conferences internal team building measures).
  • Well-earned rest: 35 vacation days per year, sport offerings, massages, a football table and a relaxing lounge area.
  • Mental health support: With our employee assistance program you have free and confidential access to resources and support for your well-being and stress management at any time.
  • Healthy food: Together we enjoy Fairtrade coffee with organic milk or oat milk, snacks and fresh fruit - all free of charge - as well as subsidized lunch from the Foodji fridge.
  • Free Tuesday Lunch: Every Tuesday, enjoy a complimentary and varied lunch.
  • Good accessibility: Choose how you would like to come to the office with a leased e-bike, by train or via highways A96/A99 (you can charge your e-car on site for free).
  • Team spirit: Regular employee and team events (virtual or on-site) ensure excellent collaboration with colleagues around the world.
  • Sustainability and social commitment: DocuWare stands for paperless work and supports volunteer organizations and local sports clubs.
  • Planning for your future: DocuWare subsidizes your company pension plan!
  • We offer a stable job with a well established and growing company.
  • Unique benefits: Choose one of three great options (Bonago, E-Gym or subsidized Deutschlandticket) to suit your needs.
  • We only use the latest technologies - find out more on Stackshare.
  • Up to 30 Days Work from Abroad: Experience international opportunities and broaden your horizons.
  • Family First: Preferential registration in our selected daycare center in Germering (no guarantee).
  • Buddy Program: You'll be paired with a buddy, who will support you during your onboarding and offer valuable tips.
For better insights, check us out on Instagram!

data.title: Account Executive/Sales (m/f/d)
data.description:
Role

Hive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.
As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO.
This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers.


Responsibilities

  • Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.
  • Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.
  • Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.
  • Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.
  • Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.
  • Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts.
  • Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base.
  • Get a trial agreement signed before any trial starts: scope, duration, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract. You drive it, Operations owns the paperwork.
  • Close, and hand over cleanly. Request the contract from Operations, keep the customer and the internal side moving, and sign. Then hand over to Operations as a confirmed customer order and to the Field Application Engineer for onboarding.
  • Keep the pipeline honest: stage discipline, forecast and CRM hygiene, and a weekly pipeline review you run for the founders


Requirements

Must Have

  • 7+ years in B2B sales of technical products into complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally in a scale up company
  • You have sold hardware, or hardware combined with software and firmware: physical systems with configurations, lead times, integration work and delivery commitments behind them
  • Comfortable selling to technical and non-technical stakeholders in the same room, and knowing when to bring in the engineers
  • Hands-on daily work in a CRM and a disciplined qualification method (e.g. MEDDPICC): your forecast is something the company can plan on
  • Closer's mindset: you treat an opportunity without a next step and a date as a problem, not a pipeline entry
  • Structured working style: your offers, decisions and customer commitments are written down so that Operations, the field team and the founders can act on them without asking
  • Willingness to travel 30–50 % across Germany and Europe, occasionally beyond Europe
  • Fluent English (German is a very big plus)
  • Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting for access to some customer sites
Nice to Have
  • An existing network or experience selling to the DACH defense ecosystem: armed forces, procurement offices, primes, integrators
  • Technical fluency in RF communication, embedded systems, unmanned systems, command-and-control or robotics
  • Experience building a sales pipeline or sales function from scratch rather than inheriting one

Lerne in unserem Bereich Business Intelligence & Process Automation digitale Strukturen und Herausforderungen in einem stark wachsenden und innovativen Unternehmen kennen!

  • Agentische KI & Automatisierung: Du bringst KI bei smartvillage in den echten Einsatz: nicht als Spielwiese, sondern in produktiven Prozessen. Du unterstützt beim Bau LLM-basierter Agenten und Automatisierungen, konzipierst Prompt- und Context-Design, bindest APIs an und sorgst für saubere, verlässliche Outputs inklusive sinnvoller Human-in-the-Loop-Logik.

Du nimmst Dir konkrete Abläufe vor: Rechnungsverarbeitung, Abstimmungen, Reporting-Workflows und KPI-Dashboards werden mit KI und Automatisierung smarter. Dabei lernst Du nebenbei, wie modernes Controlling und Accounting in einem wachsenden Unternehmen funktioniert.

Du nimmst Dir eigenständig Prozesse aus verschiedenen Bereichen vor, erkennst Automatisierungspotenziale und setzt sie um. Dabei nutzt Du Tools wie n8n, Make oder Python-Skripte und bindest Automatisierungen an unser CRM (HubSpot) und weitere interne Systeme an.

  • Integration & Systemlandschaft: Du verbindest Deine Automatisierungen mit unserer bestehenden Infrastruktur: HubSpot, PostgreSQL und interne Anwendungen. Du sorgst für saubere Datenflüsse zwischen den Bereichen und denkst in Systemen, nicht in Silos.

data.title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
data.description:
Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth.

Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network.

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business.

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem.
  • You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities.
  • You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems.
  • You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability.
  • You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.
  • You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.
  • You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes.


Skills

  • Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus).
  • Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics.
  • Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation.
  • Business fluency in both English and German is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff. 


What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

Transparency // We want to be transparent, also when it comes to salary: If you have any questions about a possible salary range for this position, feel free to send us an email at ----- We will get back to you as soon as possible.

data.description:
Darauf kannst du dich freuen

⛱️ 30 Tage Urlaub  ⌛ Flexible Arbeitszeiten✨ Regelmäßiges Arbeiten aus dem HO✈️ Bis zu 4 Wochen im Jahr Work & Travel  ⭐ Events✔️ 20% Zuschuss zu bAV oder BU  ✔️ Jobrad  ✔️ Hansefit ✔️ Günstiges Deutschlandticket❤️ Wertschätzendes Miteinander  ⭐ Vielfalt & Offenheit


Vorabinformationen

Während des 12-monatigen Traineeprogramms bekommst du die Chance dich stetig neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, dein persönliches Netzwerk auszubauen und relevante Bereiche eines eCommerce-Unternehmens kennenzulernen (z.B. Produktmanagement, (Produkt-)Marketing, Vertrieb, HR, Logistik, Einzelhandel, etc.). Der Schwerpunkt deines Traineeships ist das Produktmanagement.

Deine Rotation in andere Fachbereiche passen wir genau auf deine Erfahrungswerte und Fähigkeiten an.

Nutze die Chance und entwickle dich zum fachlichen Experten oder optimiere im Anschluss an das Traineeship unsere Abläufe im Unternehmen.


Das ist deine Rolle in unserem Team

#Einkauf:
Du unterstützt bei der Abwicklung und Koordination von Einkaufs- und Beschaffungsaktivitäten. 
#Marktanalyse: 
Zahlen sind dein Ding! Du wirst lernen Kalkulationen oder Reports zu erstellen und die Konkurrenz sowie Preisentwicklungen stets im Auge zu behalten.
#Produktmanagement: 
Nach dem Traineeprogramm sollst du deinen ersten kleinen Bereich übernehmen, dabei wirst du zum Ansprechpartner für Kollegen aus anderen Fachabteilungen und arbeitest eng mit dem Produktmarketing bei der Steuerung von Produktkampagnen zusammen.
#Perspektiven:
Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten, nutze die Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem Wachstumsunternehmen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Du bekommst von Tag 1 an einen Mentor an deine Seite gestellt, der dich auf deinem Weg begleitet.
#Team: 
Wir arbeiten auf allen Hierarchieebenen eng zusammen und sind vom Vorstand bis Azubi per ‚Du‘. Du kannst dich jederzeit auf dein Team verlassen. Dieses lernst du im digitalen Probearbeiten kennen.
#Weiterbildung: 
Vieles ist learning-on-the-job, aber wir schicken dich auch auf firmeneigene Fortbildungsprogramme.
#Steile Lernkurve:  
Du übernimmst schnell Verantwortung für Teilprojekte oder sogar kleine Hersteller. Wir geben dir die Tools an die Hand, sodass du nach einem Jahr eigenständig Produkte betreuen kannst. Und dein Einsatz bleibt nicht unbeachtet - wir sind stolz darauf, über 90% unserer Trainees in eine Festanstellung zu übernehmen.
#Arbeitsumfeld: 
Unser Arbeitskonzept sieht eine Mischung aus mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten aus dem Büro heraus vor. Je nach Einsatzbereich kann die Anzahl der Büroarbeitstage variieren. 


Was solltest du mitbringen?

#Background:
Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung absolviert und möchtest nun ins Berufsleben starten. Vielleicht hast du sogar schon praktische Erfahrungen im eCommerce-Umfeld, Produktmanagement oder Marketing sammeln können?
#Leidenschaft: 
Technik lässt dein Herz höherschlagen - ein Expertenwissen rund um Elektronikprodukte musst du jedoch nicht mitbringen. Dank deiner sehr guten Auffassungsgabe findest du dich nämlich schnell in neue Produktbereiche ein und baust Fachwissen dazu auf.  
#Verhandlungsgeschick: 
Du bist aufgeschlossen und überzeugst deine Gesprächspartner mit deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinen sehr guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Dazu hast du noch ein Gespür für gute Deals und erreichst damit beste Einkaufspreise.
#Persönlichkeit:

data.title: Data Platform Engineer (f/m/d)
data.description:
Your mission

We have challenging tasks for you:

As a Data Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for building and evolving modern cloud platforms for Data & AI. Together with our team and our clients, you will develop platforms that can be operated in a scalable, secure, and sustainable manner.

In doing so, you will combine cloud infrastructure, platform architecture, and modern Data & AI technologies into solutions that create a stable foundation for analytics, data engineering, and AI use cases.

In detail, you will:

  • Design, build, and continuously evolve cloud-based Data & AI platforms

  • Develop platform strategies and target architectures together with our clients and implement them technically

  • Design scalable and robust platform architectures that serve as a foundation for data-driven solutions

  • Provision modern cloud infrastructures on Azure or AWS automatically using Infrastructure as Code

  • Work specifically with Terraform or OpenTofu as well as modern CI/CD processes

  • Design and evolve Databricks platforms regarding workspaces, compute, networking, identity, security, and governance

  • Make architecture decisions and establish best practices for performance, security, governance, scalability, and cost optimization

  • Develop reusable platform blueprints, standards, and automations

  • Evaluate new technologies and platform components and integrate them meaningfully into existing architectures

  • Support data, analytics, and AI teams by providing stable and high-performance platforms

  • Contribute to technical concepts, architecture workshops, and the further development of our standards together with our team


Your profile

What we are looking for

You work in a structured manner, think in terms of platforms and architectures, and implement technical solutions cleanly and sustainably.

Ideally, you bring to the table:

  • Sound experience in building modern cloud infrastructures and platform architectures

  • Excellent knowledge of at least one cloud platform, ideally Microsoft Azure or AWS

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, e.g., Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep, or comparable technologies

  • A strong understanding of scalable, secure, and maintainable system and platform architectures

  • Experience with technologies in the Data & AI domain, particularly Databricks

  • Knowledge in areas such as cloud networking, identity & access management, security, and governance

  • Basic software development skills, e.g., with Python, as well as experience handling APIs and automation

  • Experience with Git and CI/CD

  • A solid understanding of the requirements that data, analytics, ML, and AI workloads place on a modern platform

data.title: Working Student Finance (m/w/d)
data.description:
Westbridge-Gruppe | Was uns antreibt

Gebäude und Immobilien müssen heute mehr leisten als je zuvor: effizienter werden, Ressourcen schonen und gleichzeitig wirtschaftlich betrieben werden. Dafür braucht es nicht nur intelligente Lösungen und transparente Daten, sondern auch eine leistungsfähige finanzielle Steuerung. 

Als einer der führenden Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberater für die Immobilienwirtschaft in Europa treiben wir diesen Wandel aktiv mit. Wir unterstützen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden dabei, Gebäude und Portfolios fit für die Zukunft zu machen – von der strategischen Beratung über die technische Planung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. 

Finance ist heute weit mehr als Buchhaltung und Reporting: Prozesse, Systeme und Anforderungen entwickeln sich kontinuierlich weiter und eröffnen immer neue Möglichkeiten, Finance effizienter und zukunftsorientierter aufzustellen. Für unser Team in Frankfurt am Main suchen wir daher einen Working Student Finance (m/w/d), der Finance nicht nur aus dem Studium kennt, sondern die unterschiedlichen Bereiche in der Praxis kennenlernen und aktiv an operativen Themen, Transformationsprojekten und M&A-bezogenen Fragestellungen mitarbeiten möchte.


Deine Aufgaben

Als Teil unseres Finance-Teams lernst du die unterschiedlichen Facetten von Finance aus nächster Nähe kennen und arbeitest an operativen, analytischen und projektbezogenen Fragestellungen mit. Dabei bist du eng mit unseren Funktionen Accounting & Tax, FP&A und Finance Transformation sowie den jeweiligen Directors im Austausch. Neben dem laufenden Finance-Tagesgeschäft wirkst du auch an Transformationsprojekten, M&A-bezogenen Themen und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Strukturen und -Prozesse mit. 

  • FP&A & Reporting: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Umsatz-, Kosten- und Ergebnisentwicklungen sowie bei der Aufbereitung relevanter Kennzahlen und Management-Auswertungen. Dabei erhältst du einen direkten Einblick in unsere Planungs-, Forecasting- und Reporting-Prozesse und lernst, finanzielle Entwicklungen einzuordnen und ihre wesentlichen Treiber zu verstehen.
  • Finance Transformation: Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Prozesse und wirkst bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung konkreter Verbesserungsmaßnahmen mit. Dabei begleitest du unter anderem die Automatisierung wiederkehrender Abläufe sowie die Einführung und Weiterentwicklung neuer Systeme und Technologien im Finance-Bereich.
  • M&A & PMI: Du unterstützt bei M&A-bezogenen Finance-Fragestellungen und erhältst Einblicke in Transaktionen und Due-Diligence-Prozesse. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Post-Merger-Integration: Hier wirkst du dabei mit, neu erworbene Gesellschaften in unsere Finance-Strukturen zu integrieren und Prozesse, Daten und Systeme zusammenzuführen.
  • Accounting: Du unterstützt unser Accounting-Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft und lernst dabei die zentralen Prozesse der Finanzbuchhaltung aus erster Hand kennen. Darüber hinaus wirkst du bei Monats-, Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen mit und entwickelst so ein fundiertes Verständnis dafür, wie Accounting und Reporting in der Praxis zusammenspielen.
  • Strategische Finance-Projekte: Du arbeitest an bereichsübergreifenden Finance-Projekten und aktuellen Fragestellungen mit und übernimmst dabei eigene Teilaufgaben. So erhältst du die Möglichkeit, Themen von der Analyse und Konzeption bis zur konkreten Umsetzung zu begleiten und zunehmend Verantwortung zu übernehmen.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, denkst analytisch und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein. Gleichzeitig packst du gerne selbst mit an, kommunizierst offen und klar und fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl, in dem sich Themen und Prioritäten auch kurzfristig verändern können. Dabei bringst du die nötige Flexibilität und Eigeninitiative mit, um Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Themen aktiv voranzubringen. 

  • Du bist in einem Masterstudiengang oder mindestens im vierten Fachsemster eines Bachelorstudiengangs der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang eingeschrieben und hast deinen Studienschwerpunkt im Bereich Finance, Accounting oder Controlling gesetzt.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen im Finance-Umfeld gesammelt, beispielsweise im Accounting, Controlling, FP&A, in der Wirtschaftsprüfung oder Beratung.
  • Auch bei mehreren parallel laufenden Themen behältst du den Überblick und arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und zuverlässig.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du bist digital affin, verfügst über sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse – insbesondere in Excel und PowerPoint – und arbeitest dich schnell und gerne in neue Tools und Finance-Systeme ein. Erste Erfahrungen mit Anwendungen wie DATEV, LucaNet oder Power BI sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-basierten Tools und setzt diese gezielt ein, um Aufgaben effizienter zu bearbeiten, Informationen zu strukturieren und die Qualität deiner Arbeitsergebnisse zu verbessern.


So arbeiten wir

Bei uns bist du nicht auf einen einzelnen Finance-Bereich festgelegt. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams aus Accounting & Tax, FP&A und Finance Transformation zusammen und erhältst dadurch einen umfassenden Einblick in unterschiedliche Finance-Disziplinen und deren Zusammenspiel. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie den jeweiligen Directors zusammen. 

Dabei kannst du dein Wissen aus dem Studium unmittelbar in der Praxis anwenden und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterentwickeln. Wir arbeiten dich strukturiert in deine Aufgaben ein, erwarten aber gleichzeitig, dass du dich proaktiv einbringst, mitdenkst und Themen eigenständig vorantreibst. Mit zunehmender Erfahrung geben wir dir die Möglichkeit, mehr Verantwortung und eigene Aufgabenpakete zu übernehmen. Uns ist wichtig, dass du nicht nur zuschaust, sondern von Beginn an aktiv mitarbeitest und einen echten Beitrag zu unserem Finance-Team leistest. 

Was uns besonders auszeichnet, ist unser Team: Wir sind ein junges, ambitioniertes Finance-Team mit hoher Dynamik, kurzen Abstimmungswegen und einem starken Zusammenhalt. Wir arbeiten fachlich anspruchsvoll, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und haben gleichzeitig Spaß daran, gemeinsam Dinge voranzubringen. Dabei schätzen wir den direkten und offenen Austausch und geben guten Ideen unabhängig von Rolle oder Erfahrung den nötigen Raum. 

Dein Studium steht weiterhin im Mittelpunkt: Während des Semesters kannst du uns bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen, in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit nach Absprache auch in Vollzeit.


Dein nächster Schritt

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und mit dir darüber zu sprechen, wie dein nächster beruflicher Schritt aussehen soll – und ob wir der richtige Partner dafür sind.

data.title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
data.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.
  • Talk to customers regularly and turn what you learn into design decisions
  • Help build and maintain a pragmatic design system that fits how we ship


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • B2B product design experience — you've designed complex software for professional users, not only consumer apps
  • A portfolio showing data-heavy, workflow-driven product work, and the reasoning behind it
  • Comfort working as a solo designer: you set your own process, make calls without waiting for sign-off, and know when "good enough to learn from" beats "perfect"
  • An early-stage mindset — priorities shift as we learn, and you treat ambiguity as something to work through, not around
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills; fluent in Figma
  • Willingness to talk to users directly and bring evidence into design discussions
  • Clear communication in English; German at a professional working level, since most of our customers operate in German and you'll need to understand their feedback directly
Nice to have:
  • Experience with industrial, manufacturing, energy, IoT, or other operational software
  • Familiarity with time-series data, dashboards, or monitoring and alerting products
  • Some front-end understanding — enough to work closely with engineers on feasibility and detail


How You’ll Grow

As the sole designer on a core product team, you'll set the design practice for Energy Insights largely on your own terms — there's no senior designer above you dictating process. You'll work closely enough with customers and engineers to see the direct consequences of your decisions, and as the product and team grow, you'll have the option to shape whether and how a design function scales beyond you.


What You Get

  • Real ownership: your designs define how industrial customers experience the product
  • Direct impact on a product that helps companies cut energy waste and costs
  • A small, senior-leaning team with short decision paths and close access to customers
  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Hybrid setup based in our Munich office, with regular in-person days alongside the team


The Application

Send us your CV and portfolio — we don't do long forms or generic cover letters. Surprise us.

data.title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
data.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

data.title: Senior Go Engineer, Full Stack
data.description:
Your mission

We're looking for product-minded engineers to join our diverse and driven team. We really value collaboration, making an impact, and continuous learning. Our product development team is based in Berlin, but we have folks working all over Europe, and you'll work closely with an experienced and supportive team.


Your profile

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer with deep expertise in Go to join a diverse, product-minded team that values collaboration, impact, and continuous learning. 

We're a distributed engineering team working across Europe (within +/- 1 hour of CET); topi is headquartered in Berlin. Engineers are expected to be comfortable navigating the entire stack (both Frontend and Backend).

In this role, you will be architecting features from the database to the browser. Your center of gravity is the Go backend, APIs, data models, system design, but you'll move into the React/TypeScript frontend whenever the feature requires it. You'll join an experienced and supportive team where you'll have a significant voice in shaping both our technical direction and the product itself.
     About You
This is a role for an engineer who lives in the backend but enjoys reaching across the stack. You'll thrive here if you can:

  • Own the Full Lifecycle: Build, scale, and maintain modern web applications where the heavy lifting sits in our Go backend, with the willingness to ship in React/TypeScript on the frontend whenever a feature calls for it.    
  • Bridge the Gap: Design and implement clean APIs in Go while ensuring they are seamlessly integrated into a performant, accessible React frontend.
  • Architect for Scale: Maintain high standards for code quality and performance across the entire stack, from backend microservices to frontend component libraries.
  • Collaborate Broadly: Work closely with Product and Design to turn ambiguous requirements into polished features.
  • Agentic Engineering Mindset: You treat AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, and the like) as real collaborators, not autocomplete. You own every line that ships under your name, whether you typed it or an agent did. You're motivated to deep-dive into agent workflows and bring the judgment that turns agent output into production-grade code.

To Be Successful in This Role, You'll Need:
  • Experience: at least 6+ years of professional software engineering experience in a production environment.
  • The Backend: Proven experience architecting and maintaining high-scale web APIs. You've shipped Go in production for 2+ years and are comfortable owning backend system design end-to-end.
  • The Frontend: Motivated and willing to work in our React/TypeScript frontend, with enough baseline ability to ship features there when a story calls for it. Prior hands-on React/TypeScript experience is a plus, not a must.
  • System Ownership: A "DevOps" mindset, comfortable with CI/CD, automated testing, and version control.
  • Communication: Fluent English and the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
What we care about
  • Teamwork: collaborating and supporting each other within engineering and across functions
  • Inclusion: creating an environment where everybody can bring their whole self and do their best work
  • Ownership: empowering you to do the work that is most impactful
  • Sustainability: balancing work with family and personal hobbies so we can be at our best
  • Growth: supporting each other's learning and development


Why topi?

  • Impact from Day One - Your ideas are valued, and you actively shape our direction. No long feedback loops or complex hierarchies - you'll have a direct impact on what you do.
  • Trust - We believe in our mission and in our team, offering trust-based working hours, permanent contracts, flexibility for home-country working.
  • Flexibility - We offer flexible working hour arrangements to ensure a healthy work-life balance.
  • Team Spirit - Shared rituals connect us, whether online or offline. We have regular formats like all-hands 
  • meetings, demo sessions, quizzes, and offsites - perfect opportunities to spend time as a team.
  • Personal Growth - Learn from experienced colleagues and leverage the latest technologies and methodologies to succeed in your role.

data.description:
About us:

Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/f/d) | Elternzeitvertretung / Parental Leave Cover
Fixed-term, around12 months  |  ideally part-time (60–80%), with the option to extend to full-time  |  Berlin (hybrid)  |  Recruiting for SRLabs and Allurity group companies
based candidates.

Please apply only if you are based in Berlin and has right to work. No visa sponsor available, No remote options available.

About us
SRLabs is home to some of the sharpest minds in cybersecurity. We secure critical infrastructures in finance, energy, and telecommunications — not through compliance checklists, but through hands-on hacking resilience. Our work lives at the intersection of deep technical research and impactful consulting for organisations that care about staying ahead of real threats.
We're a team of 60 people based in Berlin, with colleagues from all over the world. We're part of Allurity, a European cybersecurity group of 12+ sister companies, which gives us scale without sacrificing our startup energy.

We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to cover a parental leave for around 12 months. In this role, you won't just recruit for SRLabs — you'll also support hiring across several of our Allurity sister companies, working closely with our cross-company People Hub. It's a great opportunity to get hands-on, end-to-end recruiting experience across a range of technical and business roles, in an organisation that takes hiring seriously without drowning it in process.


Your responsibilities

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own end-to-end recruiting for open roles at SRLabs and selected Allurity sister companies — from intake call to signed offer.
  • Write and post compelling, accurate job ads that speak to the kind of people we want to attract.
  • Screen applications and conduct first-round interviews, giving candidates a fair, fast, and human process.
  • Coordinate interview loops with hiring managers and technical interviewers, and keep candidates informed at every step.
Sourcing
  • Proactively source candidates for harder-to-fill and technical roles via LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and other channels.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring role types across the group.
  • Help identify and test new sourcing channels, particularly for niche cybersecurity talent.
Cross-Company Collaboration
  • Partner with hiring managers and People colleagues across Allurity sister companies to understand their hiring needs and local market context.
  • Contribute to shared recruiting standards, templates, and best practices via the People Hub.
  • Support group-wide initiatives such as the graduate/internship pilot and employer-branding activities where relevant.
Candidate & Hiring Manager Experience
  • Be the main point of contact for candidates throughout the process — approachable, responsive, and clear.
  • Coach hiring managers on structured interviewing and help them make confident, fair decisions.
  • Gather feedback to continuously improve the candidate and hiring manager experience.
Systems & Process
  • Keep our ATS/Personio data accurate and up to date — job postings, pipelines, candidate statuses, and reporting.
  • Maintain recruiting-related documentation and help keep our hiring process easy to follow for everyone involved.
  • Track basic recruiting metrics (time-to-fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness) and flag bottlenecks early.


What do you bring?

  • Proven technical recruiting experience (agency or in-house) — this is a must. You've hired engineers, security specialists, or comparable technical profiles, and you can hold a credible conversation with them. This isn't a role for a first-time recruiter, but you don't need to be senior either.
  • A bit of hands-on sourcing know-how — comfortable using LinkedIn Recruiter or similar tools, and not afraid of a Boolean search string.
  • Good communication skills in both German and English — you can run a candidate conversation and write a clear job ad in either.
  • A structured, organised way of working — you keep pipelines tidy and don't let candidates fall through the cracks.
  • Genuine affinity for tech and cybersecurity talent — you don't need to code yourself, but you understand technical roles well enough to assess and engage the people in them.
  • Comfortable working across multiple companies and stakeholders at once, with a good sense for adapting your approach to different teams and cultures.
  • Ownership mentality — you follow through, flag issues early, and don't wait to be told what's next.
  • Based in Berlin, with an existing right to work in Germany.


What awaits you with us?

  • A front-row seat in the world of cybersecurity — one of the most interesting and relevant fields there is right now.
  • Real end-to-end ownership of recruiting across multiple companies, not just req-filling.
  • A close-knit, international team that takes the work seriously but doesn't take itself too seriously.
  • 30 days of paid vacation (pro-rated for the contract term).
  • Learning budget for courses or conferences relevant to your role.
  • BVG public transport pass and gym membership discounts.
  • German language lessons (if you need them).
  • Flexible home office.
  • Exposure to group-wide People initiatives and colleagues across 12+ Allurity sister companies.
 
This is a fixed-term position (Elternzeitvertretung) for approximately 12 months, covering a parental leave. It starts as a part-time role at 60–80%, with the option to move to full-time during the contract term depending on hiring volume. There's a real possibility of a handover period with the current role holder to ensure continuity.


Apply now

SRLabs is committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on any basis — we welcome applications from all qualified individuals.

Sound like you? We'd love to hear from you.

data.title: Working Student – Talent & Operations
data.description:
About Apheris

At Apheris, we are building the future of how AI is applied in pharmaceutical R&D. We enable leading pharmaceutical teams to discover and develop drugs faster. We host the industry’s largest federated data networks for drug discovery AI, spanning co-folding, ADMET, and antibody developability. 

Across these networks, models are trained on proprietary industry datasets to achieve higher performance and broader applicability while keeping data control and IP protected. We deliver these superior models through drug discovery applications that enable teams to run them at scale, further customize them, and integrate them into existing R&D workflows. 

  • AI Structural Biology (AISB) Network: Pharmaceutical companies collaborate in the field of co-folding, structure-based binding affinity predictions and antibody design.
  • ADMET Network: Pharmaceutical and biotech companies collaborate to improve small-molecule property prediction and expand into further drug modalities.
  • Antibody Developability Network: Pharma partners collaborate to federate historical and purpose-built antibody developability data sets for secure ML training, without data leaving each partner’s environment.


About the role

As our Working Student – Talent and Operations, you will support the People, Operations & Talent Acquisition functions. What we expect from you

  • Based in Berlin and able to work from our office on a regular basis

Seit der Gründung im Jahr 1990 ist JACOB weit gekommen: Im Laufe der Jahrzehnte haben wir uns von einem regionalen Ladengeschäft in Karlsruhe zu einem bedeutenden IT-Dienstleister für Unternehmen entwickelt. Unser fester Wille, immer wieder innovative Ansätze zu suchen, hat diese Entwicklung erst ermöglicht.
 
Und diese Kreativität, gepaart mit Fachkompetenz, nehmen wir in die Zukunft mit. Wir möchten uns weiterentwickeln und dabei beibehalten, was uns ausmacht. Gehst du diesen Weg mit uns?

Das Team IT Infrastructure der JACOB Elektronik GmbH sucht Verstärkung!

Senior Systems Engineer Linux (m/w/d)

Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklungsteams zusammen, bringst deine Expertise in technische Entscheidungen ein und treibst die Qualität sowie Zukunftsfähigkeit unserer IT-Landschaft aktiv voran.

Git <3, Debian GNU/Linux, SaltStack, Terraform, Nutanix, Proxmox/Incus, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, RabbitMQ, Icinga, Prometheus, HAProxy, nginx, Apache, nftables, FreeRADIUS, Docker, Kubernetes, Gitlab, AWS (EKS, ECS, Cloudfront, RDS, ...)

data.description:
Job description

Who we are 
Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. Kranus Health is a digital therapeutics platform running in several countries across urology and gynecology. Our newest therapy, Kranus Mictera, treats urinary incontinence in women, a condition that affects one in three women and that almost no onetakes seriously. Our therapies are built together with leading clinicians and scientists, prescribed by doctors, and reimbursed by health insurers, whichmeans everything you ship reaches patients with a real diagnosis instead of a wellness audience. We are ~50 people, everyone here owns outcomes ratherthan tickets, and AI is a settled part of how we work, so you won't be stuck in 2022 tooling here. One platform, many therapies, 3 countries. Small team. Big impact. If you live and breathe change, you will feel at home here.

The Role
As our Product Manager in charge of our consumer-facing Digital Therapeutics, you will lead the way to transform our platform of therapies from good to first-class with taste. This is not a feature-shipping role. We want someone who thinks in user journeys, obsesses over behavior change, and can tell the difference between a product that works and one that genuinely moves patients forward.

Your responsibilities

  • Therapy ownership: You own the full patient journey end-to-end – from the moment a doctor prescribes the therapy, through onboarding and the active therapy phase, to the point where patients feel a real difference and stay. AI is part of the work and part of the product – but it's a means to an end, not the goal itself. 
  • Behavior & retention: You apply proven knowledge of habit loops, nudges, feedback systems, and engagement mechanics to drive sustainable usage. 
  • Mobile ownership: You own our therapy apps across urology and gynecology end-to-end. 
  • App Store excellence: You treat ratings, store presence, and ASO as core product levers, and actively optimize the funnel from impression to activation.


YOUR TOOLKIT

  • Mobile expertise: Hands-on product management experience with consumer mobile apps. 
  • Platform fluency: You understand the technical realities of iOS and Android and know how to work with them – not around them. 
  • Data & AI fluency: You use AI to move fast, know when it's hallucinating, and back every decision with analytics and experiments, because you own the outcome.
  •  Languages: Fluent in German and English. 
  • High agency: You naturally push topics forward, bring people along, and don't wait to be asked. 
  • Taste: You know what a great, beautiful, yet functional product needs to look like in 2026. 
  • Optional – health or behavior background: Experience building patient-centric or behavior-change products, or genuine passion for it.


OUR SUPPORT AND YOUR BENEFITS

  • Impact - work with meaning? Together with you we improve the health care of patients, every day.
  • Teamwork - You are part of a highly motivated team with flat hierarchies and a lot of fun at work.


CONTACT

Sounds like your next chapter? We'd love to receive your application! If you have any questions about the role or Kranus, feel free to reach out directly to our Senior People & Recruiting Manager, Annkathrin -----

data.title: Senior Engineering Project Manager (m/w/d)
data.description:
The Role: What to expect

Idealworks builds industrial automation as a coordinated system — mobile robots, orchestration software, simulation, and increasingly humanoids and physical AI, working together in real production environments rather than as isolated pilots. Since our founding within BMW Group and our integration into Agile Robots SE, we've grown from a Munich-based robotics team into a global player.

As physical AI and humanoid robotics move from research into industrial deployment, our project landscape is expanding: today's programs span classic mobile robot fleets, next-generation humanoid platforms, and the simulation environments used to develop and validate both. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Project Manager to lead this kind of work end to end - technically credible enough to sit with R&D and hardware/software engineering, and organized enough to keep shareholders, partners, and customers aligned as programs move from concept to production.


Role Responsibilities: What you will do

Project & Program Delivery

  • Manage complex engineering projects across the full lifecycle — from scoping and planning through execution, integration, testing, and handover — spanning both software and hardware workstreams.
  • Define and manage project plans, milestones, budgets, and resourcing; monitor schedule, cost, quality, and contractual compliance throughout.
  • Identify technical, schedule, and commercial risks early, and drive mitigation and contingency planning across multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Plan and coordinate integration and validation phases (e.g., factory and site acceptance testing) across hardware, software, and systems components.

Cross-Functional & Technical Coordination
  • Act as the connective layer between product management, partner management, solution engineering, software development, hardware development, R&D, innovation management, and operations — ensuring each function's inputs and dependencies are captured and sequenced correctly.
  • Work closely with engineering leads on cutting-edge developments in mobile robots, humanoid platforms, simulation tooling, and physical AI to translate technical realities into realistic, defensible project plans.
  • Support innovation and R&D initiatives as they mature into deployable projects, helping bridge the gap between exploratory work and production-grade delivery.

Stakeholder & Partner Management
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for a diverse stakeholder landscape, including shareholders, technology and integration partners, and customers, tailoring communication to each audience.
  • Prepare and lead steering committee meetings, status reviews, and escalation discussions; ensure decisions are documented and followed through.
  • Manage claims, change requests, and contract or scope amendments in coordination with commercial and legal stakeholders.
  • Build long-term, trust-based relationships with partners and customers that extend beyond a single project milestone.

Operational Excellence
  • Track and report on project and portfolio KPIs (schedule adherence, cost/margin, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction) to leadership and shareholders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of project management methodology, tooling, and best practices across the organization.
  • Support resource planning and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent engineering projects.


Role Requirements: What you need to succeed

  • At least 5 years of experience in a similar role, or in a technical role such as engineering, software development, product management, program management, project management, or partner management, within the robotics industry or a domain of comparable technical complexity (e.g., autonomous systems, industrial automation, advanced hardware/software integration).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional engineering projects that combine hardware and software development.
  • Strong technical fluency to engage credibly with R&D, software, and hardware engineers on cutting-edge topics in mobile robotics, humanoids, simulation, or physical AI, without needing to be the domain expert yourself.
  • A track record of managing external stakeholders e.g. customers, partners, or investors including steering committees, escalations, and commercial discussions.
  • Solid grounding in project management fundamentals: planning, budgeting, risk management, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and business/executive audiences.
  • A degree in engineering, computer science, software development, mechatronics, robotics, or a related technical field is a plus.
  • Fluency in English required; German is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as project needs require.


Why idealworks

  • At idealworks, you will find an international working environment and become part of an experienced, open team where mutual trust counts. You will feel at home from the very first second!
  • Experience a first-hand start-up feeling and flat hierarchies with varied and responsible tasks that you work on independently.
  • Look forward to hybrid working model with 30 vacation days per year and various opportunities to balance your free time, family and job.
  • For your commitment to helping us achieve our mission, you will not only be rewarded with appreciation, but also with above-average pay including a bonus scheme and an annual personal development budget.
  • We offer exciting corporate benefits, an attractive company pension scheme and regular team events.
  • Our modern office is easily accessible by public transport, bike and car and offers numerous catering options for relaxed lunch breaks with your team.
  • Driven by our unique corporate culture, the five values "passion for results", "wellbeing", "personal growth", "trust" and "being and acting as one team" determine our daily actions and cooperation.

data.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the latest — Privacy Pro. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include:

  • Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working

  • Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews

  • Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage

 

As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer, you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo.

About You

  • 7+ years of experience building and debugging complex web applications with vanilla JavaScript.

  • Detailed knowledge of web standards, web components, and browser APIs. Any additional experience with our stack is a bonus: Swift/Kotlin/C#/C++/Python.

  • Advanced ability to reverse-engineer obfuscated third-party code and reduce issues to minimal test cases.

  • Passion for hunting elusive bugs and tracing them to their root cause.

  • Interest in automating repetitive work and building agentic tooling that multiplies the team's impact.

  • Experience triaging issues, leading incident response, and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience shipping code beyond the web, like native or desktop clients.
