data.title: QA Engineer Mobile
data.description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Mobile QA Engineer to lead end-to-end quality assurance, test automation, and release stability for our ScholarshipOwl Flutter mobile appand its integration with our GraphQL API. You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring rapid, regression-free delivery across iOS, Android, and Shorebird OTA updates for millions of students.

In this role, you will champion the "new generation" of quality engineering. Beyond traditional test automation, you will leverage modern AI coding assistants (such as Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini) as your primary force multiplier to achieve maximum test coverage at unmatched speed. Working closely with mobile and backend teams across a modern multi-service architecture, you will shift quality left, auditing Figma specs before sprint commitments, reviewing PRs, and maintaining continuous quality gates in our CI/CD pipelines.

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-End Web Automation: Build, maintain, and execute parallelized E2E smoke and regression test pipelines using Patrol integrated directly into Codemagic and GitLab CI pipeline.

  • API & Contract QA: Establish automated contract and API integration testing to validate GraphQL schema updates against mobile query requirements, guaranteeing zero breaking changes.

  • AI Integration: Deeply integrate AI tools (Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) into daily workflows to generate Patrol scripts directly from Figma specs, synthesize complex mock payloads, and automate log triage to double QA efficiency.

  • Shift-Left Quality Champion: Review feature specs in Figma and GraphQL schema definitions early to catch edge cases, logic gaps, and design flaws before sprint commitments and development begin. Participate actively in PR reviews.

  • System Observability & Triage: Monitor build health, Firebase Remote Config/Analytics, Sentry error logs, and GCP Cloud Run logs to triage issues across Flutter BLoC/UI state, GraphQL resolvers, and backend services, logging rich GitLab issues with dev-ready context.

  • Exploratory & Release Testing: Conduct testing across iOS Simulators, Android Emulators, physical devices, TestFlight, Google Play Console internal tracks, and Shorebird OTA hot-patches.

  • Component Testing: Utilize Flutter Storybook to conduct visual regression and component-level testing early in the release lifecycle.


Required Qualifications (Must Haves)

  • Experience Level: 3+ years of professional experience in Mobile QA Engineering / Test Automation, with at least 1+ year actively incorporating AI coding tools into daily workflows.

  • Mobile Automation Mastery: Hands-on experience with Flutter automation frameworks (Patrol, Flutter Integration Test, or strong Appium/XCUITest/Espresso skills with eager readiness to master Patrol).

  • API & Schema Verification: Proficiency in testing GraphQL APIs (Bruno, Postman, Playwright, or HTTP clients), including schema validation, headers, and JWT auth flows.

  • Mobile Ecosystem & Design: Comfort inspecting Figma files for UI specs/design tokens, using Xcode/Android Studio tools, managing Firebase Remote Config & feature flags, and navigating mobile app deployment lifecycles (Apple App Store / TestFlight, Google Play Console internal testing).

  • CI/CD & Mobile DevOps: Experience with mobile CI/CD tools (Codemagic, GitLab CI) and Git/GitLab workflows.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in software development / test automation.

  • Communication: Clear, concise async communication skills in written and spoken English for bug reporting, documentation, and remote collaboration.

Nice to Have

  • AI-Native Focus: Advanced proficiency loading architecture specs, GraphQL schemas, and UI design tokens into AI models to auto-generate test cases, Patrol page objects, and mock payloads.

  • Dart & Component Testing: Direct Dart / Flutter coding ability to write unit and widget tests in-repo, as well as Flutter Storybook experience.

  • OTA & Scripting: Experience with Shorebird (OTA hot patching for Flutter) or basic TypeScript / Bun experience for writing Bruno test collections or schema scripts.

  • Cloud Infrastructure & Feature Flags: Exposure to GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Logging) and Unleash feature flag management.

  • Certifications: Certifications in Quality Engineering, Mobile Testing, or AI-Assisted Software Engineering.

Bonus Skills (The "X-Factor")

  • Cross-Platform & GraphQL Experience: Prior experience testing cross-platform Flutter applications connected to GraphQL backends in fast-paced product companies.

  • Consumer Mobile SaaS: Previous experience testing consumer mobile apps, EdTech platforms, subscription/billing systems (Stripe, in-app purchases), or user onboarding funnels.

Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

  • Mission-Driven Work: Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities and reduce financial barriers.

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world while collaborating with a global team.

  • High Impact & Ownership: You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own your domain and directly drive results.

  • Owl Shine Program: Monthly employee recognition and awards celebrating extraordinary contributions.

  • Continuous Learning Culture: Dedicated support for curiosity, bold experimentation, and career growth.

  • Annual Global Off-sites: Connect with your teammates in person at exciting locations around the world.

data.title: Remote Maintenance Engineer
data.description:
About the role

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.


Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.


Qualification and educational requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
  • Technical experience: 
    • Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects.
    • Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry.
    • Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools.


Competences and preferred skills

  • Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments
  • Strong background in mechatronics, motion control and mechanical integration. 
  • Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset
  • Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems 
  • Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics.
  • Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis.
  • Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with other engineering disciplines.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

data.description:
Bereit, den Markt zu verändern?

PAIR Finance denkt Inkasso neu: Wir entwickeln die fortschrittlichste KI-Technologie im Forderungsmanagement und haben damit die gesamte Inkassoindustrie nachhaltig verändert. Heute sind wir mit 250+ Mitarbeitenden, 600+ Mandant*innen und Standorten in zehn europäischen Städten europaweit führend im Einsatz von KI im Forderungsmanagement – und erzielen dabei höhere Rückzahlungsquoten, ohne die Kundenbeziehung unserer Mandant*innen zu belasten.

Im Zuge der Ausgliederung entsteht die PAIR Finance Deutschland GmbH als eigenständige operative Gesellschaft für unseren Heimatmarkt. Als Managing Director / Country Head (m/w/d) Deutschland übernimmst du die unternehmerische und vertriebliche Verantwortung für diesen Aufbau: Deutschland ist der am weitesten entwickelte Markt unserer europaweit tätigen Gruppe – deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn weiter zu skalieren, zu professionalisieren und profitabel auszubauen. Du gestaltest die nächste Wachstumsphase der deutschen Gesellschaft aktiv mit. 


Was du bei uns bewegen kannst:

  • Umsatz- und Ergebnisverantwortung für den Standort Deutschland: Du steuerst Vertrieb und Neukundenakquise aktiv, verantwortest Pipeline und Forecast und triffst die zentralen kommerziellen Entscheidungen für den deutschen Markt.
  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Vertriebsstrategie für den deutschen Markt, inklusive Priorisierung unserer Schwerpunktindustrien (E-Commerce, Medien & Entertainment, Banken & Versicherungen, Mobility, Energieversorger) und – in Abstimmung mit der Gruppe – dem Einsatz gezielter Collection-Strategien.
  • Akquise neuer Mandant*innen sowie systematischer Ausbau bestehender Partnerschaften: du trägst die Verantwortung für ambitionierte Neugeschäfts- und Wachstumsziele.
  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines vertriebsstarken, motivierten Teams mit klarer Ziel- und Ergebnisorientierung.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem C-Level der Gruppe und den internationalen Country MDs, um pan-europäische Kunden für PAIR Finance zu gewinnen, Vertriebs-Best-Practices gruppenweit zu teilen und Vertriebsstrategien europaweit auszurollen.
  • Positionierung von PAIR Finance am deutschen Markt zur Unterstützung deiner Vertriebsziele – z. B. durch Pressemitteilungen, eigene Vorträge und Auftritte auf Konferenzen, Messen und Webinaren, sowie Weiterentwicklung der Marketingstrategie und Organisation von Kundenevents.
  • Rechtskonformität am Standort: Sicherstellung in enger Abstimmung mit der zentralen Legal & Compliance-Funktion, die hierfür die fachliche Verantwortung trägt.
Hinweis zum Geschäftsmodell: Unsere Mandant*innen (deine Kunden im Vertrieb) sind ausschließlich Unternehmen – vom E-Commerce-Player bis zum Energieversorger. Die eigentliche Forderungsbearbeitung richtet sich an Endverbraucher*innen (B2C). Dein Vertrieb ist also klassisches Enterprise-B2B-Geschäft. 


Was du dafür mitbringen solltest:

  • Mehrjährige, hochrangige Vertriebsführungserfahrung im B2B-Umfeld mit nachweisbaren Vertriebs- und Wachstumserfolgen (z. B. als Sales Director, Head of Sales oder Country Manager), idealerweise im FinTech-Bereich oder in einem regulierten Umfeld wie Inkasso, Forderungsmanagement oder Financial Services
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge im Aufbau und in der Skalierung von B2B-Vertriebsorganisationen – inklusive Verantwortung für Umsatzziele, Pipeline-Steuerung und Forecasting
  • Belastbares, kommerziell nutzbares Netzwerk zu Entscheider*innen in unseren Schlüsselbranchen (E-Commerce, Medien & Entertainment, Banken & Versicherungen, Mobility, Energieversorger)
  • Hohe Kundenorientierung und ausgeprägte Hands-on-Vertriebsmentalität – du gehst selbst aktiv auf Mandant*innen zu
  • Klare, glaubwürdige und zielgruppengerechte Kommunikation
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und starke analytische Fähigkeiten
  • Echtes Interesse an Technologie und der Anwendung von KI
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
Transparenz, Ownership, Execution, Kundenzentrierung, Innovation und Integrität sind für uns bei PAIR Finance keine Worte, sondern gelebte Praxis. Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen und setzen KI täglich aktiv ein, um effizienter zu arbeiten und jeden Tag ein bisschen erfolgreicher zu sein. Wir suchen Kolleg*innen, die diese Neugier teilen, mit kreativem Denken neue Wege ausprobieren und Lust haben, Dinge anders zu machen. 
Erkennst du dich darin wieder? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und bring deine Vertriebsstärke, Motivation und Persönlichkeit ein.

Culture & Team

data.description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we're hiring

  • We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled operators like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

  • We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

  • Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we’ll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.

  • The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.

  • We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

  • The operational machine behind Odin is still held together in many places by people and spreadsheets. Your job is to come in, understand every process and system, simplify, streamline and automate the shit out of it.

  • You’ll be part of a small elite team embedded in operations and working closely with existing team members to build agents that automate work.

  • We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else.

What you'll own

  • Understand the work, then rebuild it: You’ll get close to how our operational teams actually work - the processes, edge cases, manual steps and things that slow them down. Your job is to understand them well enough to redesign, automate and build better ways of doing them.

  • Build and automate: You’ll turn manual workflows into tools, automations and systems that make the business faster and more scalable. You’ll work autonomously and move quickly - often vibe coding something useful yourself before it ever needs traditional product or engineering resource.

  • Bridge operations and engineering: You’ll know when something can be solved with process, automation or a lightweight build, and when it genuinely needs deeper engineering work. When it does, you’ll bring Product, Design and Engineering in with the problem already understood, simplified and proven.

  • Delete things and say no: You’ll constantly question why a process exists, whether a request should be supported, and whether something is worth scaling. If a workflow exists for no good reason, you kill it. If a request creates complexity without enough value, we don’t do it.

What we're looking for

  • AI-pilled builder: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built concrete solutions to problems with no budget and no engineers. No-code tooling, scripts, spreadsheets, vibe-coded apps and more.

  • Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You’ll be working on automating a lot of numerical matters - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting.

  • In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done.

  • First principles thinker: Although you're in the details and on top of execution, you also zoom out. You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal?
    A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that.

  • Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. SQL, serious Excel and other experience piping data between systems are all worth having too. However, we care much more about the traits you have and things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV. If you're a few years into your career and you've already automated the shit out of your last job or built something incredible with AI, we want to talk to you.

  • You want to operate, not manage: Odin is not a place for middle management. We all get shit done, regardless of title or seniority

How we work

There are five things we care about deeply:

  1. Reason from the ground up: Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

  2. Speed begets speed: We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

  3. Take ownership: Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

  4. Brutal honesty: If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to.

  5. Truly excellent customer service: Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster.

This role is probably not for you if

  • You'd rather build product than operate. Product instinct is required in this role, but a product management career is not what this is;

  • You prefer close management of your responsibilities;

  • You are risk-averse;

  • You want a 9-5;

  • You take yourself too seriously;

  • You care about working for a company that’s raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact

Salary

£70k - £90k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity.

Hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one.

Location & ways of working

We're a London-based team. This role works closely with the founders, product and the wider ops team, and the speed we run at makes that much easier in-person. At least three days a week in the office.

Benefits

  • Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support

  • Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness

  • Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave

  • Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options

  • Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total)

  • Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally

  • Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave

This is a client-facing role at a firm that does things differently. There are no legacy layers here — you’ll take real ownership, shape the work, and have direct visibility of the impact you create from day one. If you’ve built strong credentials in finance transformation and want to apply them somewhere that moves at pace and actually values your expertise, this is that role.

• Implement cloud-based ERP and EPM platforms, automation tools, data platforms and analytics solutions.

• Translate business requirements into practical ERP/EPM solutions and integrate technology into clients’ ecosystems.

• Drive adoption of transformation initiatives so the changes stick after we leave.

• Run executive workshops and lead steering committee updates.

• Ensure delivery on time, on budget and within scope.

• Lead, coach and develop team members.

• Contribute to go-to-market activities, proposal writing and pitch presentations.

• Support thought leadership on EPM trends and tools.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years of experience in finance transformation including 2+ years in a consulting or advisory environment.

  • Track record of delivering high-impact tech-enabled Finance Transformation programmes.

  • Experience implementing ERP, EPM, analytics tools and automation platforms.

  • Experience in process re-engineering and operating model design.

  • Finance/Accounting qualification including ACA/ACCA/CIMA/CPA

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 

Work Environment

A truly hybrid and flexible working environment. We offer the opportunity to be at the forefront of AI-driven advisory services. You’ll be working on cutting-edge projects and encouraged to deploy the latest analytical tools and approaches.

At Unity Advisory, we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We are dedicated to ensuring that everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and are here to support you throughout the process.

data.title: Associate Product Manager (US Cards)
data.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.

A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.

If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.

About the role

We're hiring a Associate Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.

What you'll work on

  • Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

  • Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

  • Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

  • Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

  • Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

  • Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team

What we're looking for

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.

  • 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

  • You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

  • You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

  • You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

  • You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

  • You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

  • You like days that look different from each other

  • Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.

AI at Lendable

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.

Your team

You'll report to the Senior Product Manager for Customer Management, and work most closely with:

  • A developer and design team split across London and Europe, covering frontend and backend

  • A data science team building models specific to the US business

  • A credit risk team

  • A growth team

  • An operations team

The team spans our London office, remote engineers in Europe, and our office in Arlington, Virginia, near DC, which you'll visit.

Life at Lendable

  • No one here is limited to their lane. If you want to pick up credit analysis, prototype a feature or fix something in ops, you will be supported.

  • Work from home Mondays and Fridays, and be in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with lunches prepared by our top-tier in-house chefs

  • Top-tier private health insurance

  • Offsites for the US Cards product and engineering team, and an annual whole-company trip abroad (previously Turkey and France)

Interview process

We respect your time and move quickly:

  1. Intro call (remote) - 30 minutes with the hiring manager

  2. Take-home exercise (remote) - a practical product challenge in your own time, followed by a video debrief with two members of the product team

  3. Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and US Cards MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

data.title: Research Scientist, Computational Enzymology
data.description:
About us
We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient.

If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it.

We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK.

The role
You'll simulate enzyme-catalysed reactions from the physics up. Using reactive and free-energy methods you'll map how reactions proceed in the active site, compute transition states and barriers, and work out where the catalysis actually comes from: why a step has the barrier it does, which residues do the work, and how mutations move it. You'll work with the wider simulation and ML teams, but also directly with our bench scientists — seeing your predictions tested in vitro and getting experimental feedback on fast, tight loops.

What you'll do

  • Characterise mechanisms, transition states, and activation barriers in the active site, and compare computed barriers against measured kinetics

  • Pin down the origins of catalysis — the residues, interactions, and dynamics that set rate and selectivity — and use MD to understand how active-site motion shapes the reaction

  • Turn results into concrete, testable proposals for the wet lab, and fold the resulting data back into your models

  • Help physics-based and learned methods strengthen each other as we build them out

Essential experience.

  • Expertise in enzymatic reaction modelling using QM/MM and a variety of free energy methods

  • A solid grasp of enzyme catalysis: mechanism, kinetics, cofactors, and how active-site chemistry and conformational dynamics sets rate and selectivity

  • Sound judgement about method selection, good understanding o methodological limitations and computational cost

Highly preferred

  • Experience in protein design for enzymatic optimization

  • You've run design–test–refine cycles with a wet lab before

  • Experience with reactive machine-learned potentials, or coupling physics-based modelling with ML

Logistics

Compensation is highly competitive. We're also able to sponsor visas for the right candidate.

data.title: Senior Web Compatibility Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the latest — Privacy Pro. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include:

  • Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working

  • Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews

  • Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage

 

As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer, you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo.

About You

  • 7+ years of experience building and debugging complex web applications with vanilla JavaScript.

  • Detailed knowledge of web standards, web components, and browser APIs. Any additional experience with our stack is a bonus: Swift/Kotlin/C#/C++/Python.

  • Advanced ability to reverse-engineer obfuscated third-party code and reduce issues to minimal test cases.

  • Passion for hunting elusive bugs and tracing them to their root cause.

  • Interest in automating repetitive work and building agentic tooling that multiplies the team's impact.

  • Experience triaging issues, leading incident response, and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience shipping code beyond the web, like native or desktop clients.

  • Ability to lead complex, ambiguous projects with little to no oversight.

Compensation

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is identical within professional levels, regardless of geographic location or team. Compensation for each professional level is transparent across the organization.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

data.title: Technical Lead, Machine Learning
data.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Technical Lead, Machine Learning, you own the execution layer of our intelligence, turning research and model capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems.

You will work across the model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of research, systems, and product.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own the end-to-end ML systems powering our company, from data and training to evaluation, inference, and deployment.

  • Build and evolve training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models.

  • Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety, and real-world product performance.

  • Architect high-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost, and reliability.

  • Build data pipelines and systems for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data.

  • Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models.

  • Partner closely with research and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements.

  • Make pragmatic technical trade-offs and rapidly iterate based on real-world performance.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building and shipping ML systems used in production, not just research prototypes.

  • Strong understanding of modern large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference.

  • Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals.

  • Experience operating ML workloads at meaningful scale, particularly GPU-based systems.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguous problems independently.

  • A bias toward experimentation, measurement, and shipping.

  • High standards for correctness, reliability, and production quality.

 

Outcomes

  • Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets.

  • ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable.

  • Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact.

  • Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction.

  • Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time.

 

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • GPU-based training and inference system

 

Ideal Experience

  • You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos.

  • You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes.

  • You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness.

 

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

 

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

data.title: Engineering Manager – United Kingdom
data.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

data.title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
data.description:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading.

About the Role

We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers who transact on Fleek today, so they're a supply-first test rather than a two-sided cold start. Your job on a new bet is to find and onboard the supply, sell it into demand that already exists and read the economics fast.

Every bet runs through the same gates. If a bet misses its gates, you kill it with evidence and move to the next one. If it works and you're running it well, you don't have to hand it off. You scale into owning the category, with supply, acquisition and ops building out under you. Think of this seat as a venture builder inside Fleek.

One thing this is not. We're not building a sales team or a sales culture, and this is not an AE or account manager role with a new title. You'll work directly with the founders and our commercial lead, close to the centre of the company.

What You'll Do

  • Run bets through the gates: take each bet from market research to first suppliers to first GMV to a feasible-or-not call, with win metrics and kill metrics defined before you start.

  • Go where the supply is: get on planes. You'll visit suppliers, graders and rag houses in the markets your bets open up, because this trade is built face to face and the best stock never gets listed anywhere.

  • Sell supply into live demand: onboard brands, brokers, graders and wholesalers, then get Fleek's existing buyers transacting on the new inventory. The sell is fast, informal and relationship-led, over WhatsApp and Instagram as often as in a boardroom.

  • Make the kill calls: hold a clear view of unit economics and the competitive landscape on every bet. Double down or cut on evidence, not attachment.

  • Be the ops function, for now: work out importer-of-record structures, duties, freight cost and last mile for each new flow.

  • Ride the AI infrastructure: our acquisition team has spent months building the agentic outreach and enrichment engine. You'll plug your bets into it and extend it, rather than building from a blank page or adding headcount.

  • Learn the actual trade: how stock is graded, routed and priced across markets, and who's sitting on good inventory that nobody has approached. You'll get deep in it fast.

What You Bring

  • Zero-to-one is your natural habitat. You've built something from nothing as a founder, an early employee or the person who started a new line inside an existing company. You've operated without a playbook and you didn't wait for one.

  • Operator and commercial in one person. You build the machine and you carry the number. You're not pure strategy and you're not pure sales, and you're comfortable being measured on GMV within your first quarter.

  • AI fluency. You work with agents and automations daily and you'd rather build a workflow than repeat a task.

Strong signals on top of that:

  • An instinct for physical goods. You understand inventory, margins and trading relationships, or you've worked around fashion, resale or marketplaces.

  • Deals you structured yourself, at any size, that didn't exist before you wrote them.

  • Exposure to cross-border trade, logistics or supply chain operations.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience in resale, surplus or secondary-market inventory

  • Experience launching a new market, geography or product line from scratch

  • Established networks in international sourcing markets

What You'll Get

  • Generous equity: being on Fleek means you'll own a part of it

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage

  • A collaborative team in a lovely office in the heart of East London

  • Access to founders. We're a small team and they're heavily involved (and good fun!)

  • Exclusive employee discounts to buy on Fleek

  • Access to borrow any item from our collection of vintage and reworks in the office

  • A disproportionate level of responsibility and the opportunity to drive massive impact

How We Work

Fleek is an in-office company. We're based at Commercial Street, E1 (Liverpool Street / Aldgate East). We operate a fully in-person culture at our office in Shoreditch, with trust-based flexibility. We hire adults and trust them to perform.

The Practicalities

  • Location: London HQ, Commercial Street, E1 (Liverpool Street / Aldgate East)

  • Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth

  • Team: 200 across three geographies

  • Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held.

Our Values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done.

  • Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.

  • Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you.

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Our Product Delivery team is the engine that turns vision into impact. We ship early and often, getting valuable features into the hands of customers quickly and iterating from there. We work in the open by default, sharing progress and ideas, and we trust each other to own outcomes. We’re a small but mighty crew where every person plays a critical role and we’re committed to using AI to work smarter and faster.

About the Role

We're looking for an AI/ML Product Engineer to build the insight layer of Harmonic: the ML that makes sense of how people and agents are actually using AI, so our customers can see where it's creating value and where it's creating risk.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with real product impact. You'll take problems from messy raw data all the way to a shipped, customer-facing insight, working directly with product, engineering, security and the customers themselves.

This is about turning AI usage into insight that customers act on. Classification and clustering are how we do that today, but you'll choose whatever approach fits the problem. It's Python-first engineering, not notebook analysis.

What You'll Do

  • Turn raw AI usage data into insights customers can see, trust and act on

  • Own insight features end to end, from framing the question with users and product partners through to production and iteration

  • Make sense of unstructured data at scale, with the quality of every output measured and understood

  • Build and maintain the data pipelines behind your models, and own their deployment and reliability in production

  • Build the evaluation frameworks, ground-truth sets and error analysis that prove an insight holds up before a customer sees it

  • Quantify uncertainty and communicate confidence clearly, so the product never presents a shaky signal as a certain one

  • Shape the product surface itself: what the model should show, to whom, and why

  • Keep pace with a fast-moving field, adopting new models and approaches as they prove themselves and retiring the ones that don't

  • Work across a polyglot stack: Python at the core, with Java (Spring Boot) and occasionally TypeScript when the task demands it, deployed on AWS

What You Bring

  • Strong production Python for ML and data engineering – code in version control, tested and deployed, not just explored

  • Rigour about validity: you routinely report precision and recall, confidence intervals and baselines, and you've run experiments or human-in-the-loop review to verify automated conclusions

  • Experience delivering ML as part of a product team on a customer-visible surface, ideally having owned an insights, analytics or intelligence feature yourself

  • A quantitative background (statistics, CS, physics, econometrics or equivalent) applied to real data problems

  • Comfort in a polyglot codebase and a willingness to pick up a second language on the job

  • Hybrid in our Shoreditch office around two days a week, potential for Remote for exceptional candidates

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Have built products in cybersecurity, AI detection, data protection, governance or enterprise SaaS – or have a real interest in how organisations adopt AI safely

  • Have worked on taxonomy design, data labelling, or entity and intent categorisation in a product context

  • Have been an early or founding engineer or data scientist and defined the product surface yourself

  • Care whether a signal in the data is real, and will argue about sampling bias and statistical validity when it matters

  • Have translated messy data into dashboards, scores or narratives that buyers rely on

  • Want a senior IC seat with build-it-yourself scope, not a step onto a management ladder

  • Thrive in early-stage ambiguity and prefer small, fast product companies to large platform teams

  • Leverage AI tools as an engineer to help you build smarter, faster and better

Why Join Us

We're building at the intersection of AI and security, carving out an emerging market where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

data.title: Senior Product Manager
data.description:
About Userlane

Userlane is a software adoption platform that shows enterprises whether their software and AI investments are actually working. Our team works with some of the biggest names in regulated industries, helping them get real value from technology and giving their employees the right support inside software applications they use every day. Based in Munich, growing internationally.

Userlane combines Application Intelligence and Contextual Assistance for regulated industries. Application Intelligence shows where software creates cost and friction across the estate. Contextual Assistance helps people get work done in the moment, without training burden. We work with healthcare organizations across the US and Europe, helping clinical and operational teams work confidently in complex systems like EHRs and other core clinical and business applications.


Your mission

Own Application Intelligence at Userlane. You'll shape what we build across App Discovery, HEART Analytics and Portfolio Overview to help enterprise CIOs and IT leaders see where software spending delivers value and where it creates waste. You'll work on opportunities such as:

  • Defining metrics that hold up: Own the methodology behind our HEART Analytics, deciding what each score measures, how it's calculated, and how it stays credible when data is incomplete.

  • Delivering outcome-linked metrics: Connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on

  • Building for time-poor executives: Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?"

  • Connecting fragmented data sources: Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems,

  • Transforming insights into action: Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once

  • AI adoption governance: Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI.


Your profile

  • 5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation

  • You've defined a metrics methodology, scoring system or measurement framework that others build on, and you can defend the trade-offs behind it. You're comfortable reasoning about why one calculation approach produces misleading results in a specific scenario and another doesn't.

  • You start with the business question, not the data. Your first instinct is "what decision are they trying to make?" rather than "what data do we have?"

  • You hold your ground. You'll work with technically strong colleagues and leaders with well-formed opinions. You can disagree with them credibly, engage with their reasoning, and change your position when the evidence says so, not when the seniority does.

  • You can hold a credible conversation with data engineers and data scientists about what the data can and cannot prove, and you understand the difference between interesting data and actionable insight

  • You've worked in enterprise B2B (not B2C product analytics). Healthcare experience is a strong plus

  • You figure out what works by talking to customers and watching them use the product

  • You're capable of explaining things to engineers, salespeople, support agents and CEOs alike

  • You're fluent in English (spoken and written)


What's in for you

  • Team & Culture: A high-performance culture with great leadership and a fun, engaged, motivated and diverse team with people from over 20 countries

  • Impact: You'll be part of an empowered cross-functional team given the freedom and autonomy to solve real customer problems

  • Product strategy influence: Work directly with our VP Product to shape our 2026-2030 strategy as we expand into new sectors

  • Market: Userlane is among the global leaders in the rapidly growing Digital Adoption industry

  • Growth: We take you and your development seriously. You can expect weekly 121s, a personalised skills assessment and development plan, on-the-job coaching and budget for events and training
    Benefits: We offer flexible benefits related to savings and security, health and well-being, and lifestyle and leisure

Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

Context

You'll join a tight-knit team with high product standards and direct access to production deployment: our models are tested in real-world conditions, with several million users each month, with very short cycles between prototyping, integration and deployment.

In this context, you'll work on the next generation of agentic and recommendation systems: building the pipelines, agents, and models that sit at the core of our product.

Your Mission

Your goal is to build and scale the agentic infrastructure that powers Lemrock's commerce intelligence: turning raw signals into automated, self-improving systems at production scale.

Concretely, you will:

  • Analyze large-scale conversational interaction datasets (100M+ events/month) to uncover behavioral patterns, intent signals, and performance drivers.

  • Design and deploy agentic pipelines end-to-end, from data ingestion and enrichment to model orchestration, monitoring, and continuous improvement, integrated into systems exposed to millions of requests daily.

  • Build autonomous agents that keep our knowledge infrastructure accurate and current.

  • Translate insights into iteration loops in production, by updating, fine-tuning, and improving our existing recommendation and ranking algorithms with tight constraints on latency, robustness, and business outcomes.

  • Design and train new recommendation models from scratch when needed, with a focus on scalability, evaluation rigor, and deployability in real-world traffic.

Candidate Profile

  • Strong academic background (MVA, ENS, X, Central…)

  • 2+ years of experience in AI, Agentic Systems, ML / Deep Learning, statistics or NLP

  • Experience prototyping and deploying AI models into production

  • Experience with production systems (APIs, monitoring, optimization)

  • Strong interest in LLMs, recommendation and conversational systems: building agentic pipelines, agent orchestration, fine-tuning

  • Comfortable with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor)

  • Thrives in ambiguity and 0-to-1 environments

  • Fluent in English; French is a plus

Tech Stack

ML/AI (required)

  • Agentic frameworks (e.g., Langchain) and/or native SDKs like OpenAI/Anthropic

  • Observability and evaluation for LLM/agent workflows

  • Vector search, scoring, prompting, LLM orchestration

  • Hybrid recommender systems, causal inference, probabilistic models

Bonus (appreciated but not required)

  • TypeScript

  • Engineering: Docker, GCP, PostgreSQL, Redis, Vector DBs, PostHog

  • CI/CD

Why Join Us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

  • Work directly with an experienced team: two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG)

  • Be part of the next structural shift of the web: agentic interfaces

  • Own mission-critical topics, grow fast, and shape the company's future trajectory

Package

Competitive salary disclosed during the interview process.

data.title: Content Editor
data.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

We write a lot, and it's read by millions of people around the world. Our content team is already strong, and now we want to make it stronger. You'll be the native voice of the brand: everything our users read will go through you.

What you will work on

  • Reviewing and editing the team's copy across the blog, Help Center, changelog, Creator Hub, case studies, PR and news, newsletters, product updates, and UI text;

  • Fact-checking every piece before it ships: checking model and feature names against the product;

  • Keeping facts consistent across every surface, so the same number reads the same in the blog, Help Center, landing pages, and press releases;

  • Shaping content for AI answers: a direct answer up front, question-based headings, useful FAQs, and internal links;

  • Keeping the writing alive and human, with no traces of AI or template-speak;

  • Working on tone, rhythm and clarity, not just fixing grammar;

  • Writing your own pieces too, including editorial work like our Inside Higgsfield series;

  • Holding one consistent brand voice across everything we publish.

Your must haves

  • English as your native language;

  • A strong background in editing and writing, with a portfolio to show for it;

  • An instinct for style, tone and rhythm. You feel when a sentence works and when it doesn't;

  • The ability to explain your edits and how they make the text stronger. "It sounds better" is a start, not an answer;

  • An owner mindset: you see what could be better, and you make it happen;

  • Comfort with startup pace. We move fast, ship weekly, and the writing has to keep up.

Nice to have

  • Experience editing for a tech, SaaS or AI product;

  • Experience building or maintaining a style guide or brand voice;

  • Familiarity with the GenAI landscape and the tools creators actually use;

The deal

  • Competitive salary in USD;

  • Fully remote position;

  • Access to Higgsfield products and the AI tools we use internally;

  • Full-time position with high ownership and growth potential.

At Pennylane, our website is a key engine for acquisition and conversion, transforming traffic from SEO, paid acquisition, media, and partnerships into demo bookings and self-sign-ups.

 

With over 450,000 monthly visits, our website already brings together conversion, product management, engineering, and tracking. We are seeking a Team Lead Website to provide clear leadership, structure the team, and scale our conversion performance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will lead a multidisciplinary squad and ensure the website’s speed, quality, and business impact.

 
 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising clients.

 

A few figures illustrating our scale and ambition:

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

You will lead our Website squad and collaborate closely with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Gen, Data, Brand, and Automation teams.

 

Lead and Grow the Website Squad

  • Set clear roles, objectives, and rituals

  • Manage and develop multidisciplinary profiles across conversion, product, and engineering

  • Foster growth in autonomy and seniority

  • Integrate AI into daily work to accelerate processes (e.g., backlog management, landing-page creation)

  • Recruit additional talent as needed

 

Drive Conversion

  • Define and prioritize initiatives that improve demo bookings and self-sign-ups

  • Frame, challenge, and unblock projects while empowering owners

  • Enhance the pace and quality of our A/B testing program

  • Structure identification, prioritization, design, and analysis of hypotheses

  • Ensure statistical rigor and clear decision-making from experiments

  • Make experimentation a consistent driver of website performance

  • Lead brand redesigns and update commercial messaging

  • Support new product launches with self-sign-up journeys

  • Prepare the website for international expansion

  • Coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and handle competing priorities

  • Own tracking plan and conversion data quality

  • Deep understanding of experimentation and A/B testing methodologies

You will work with experimentation, tracking, and analytics tools such as AB Tasty, GA4, GTM, and Amplitude and use AI to boost squad operations and execution.

  • Direct and measurable impact on demo bookings, self-sign-ups, and company growth

data.title: Customer Care Team Lead
data.description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

Day One: Hands-On Frontline Support

  • Frontline Excellence: Personally resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat and phone, delivering high-touch support from day one.

  • Internal Product Mastery: Act as our expert power user, testing our internal OS and advocating for tool improvements that boost operational efficiency.

  • NPS & Proactive Care: Design proactive care initiatives to ensure member satisfaction remains consistently best-in-class.

Post-Ramp: Team Scale & Process

  • Team Scaling & Playbooks: Build, mentor, and lead a growing support team while writing our core SOPs, escalation pathways, and training guides.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Turn daily support interactions into structured insights that directly inform product roadmap decisions.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 2+ years in high-volume B2C customer care or support, with a track record of mentoring peers and a readiness to step into your first formal lead role.

  • Bilingual Skills: Fluent in both English and French (written and spoken).

  • People-First Energy: You bring genuine warmth, high empathy, and enthusiasm to every interaction, turning routine support into remarkable member experiences.

  • Phone-First Instinct: You default to picking up the phone whenever a complex issue calls for a personal touch.

  • Rigorous Precision: Exceptional attention to detail with zero tolerance for misquotes, incorrect details, or operational errors.

Nice to have

  • Regulated Industry Experience: Prior background in healthtech, fintech, or another high-compliance consumer space where accuracy is critical.

  • Startup Mindset: Thrives in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution, and clear communication.

  • Modern Tooling: Practical experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and boost support efficiency.

 

The process

  • Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

  • Case study interview (30-60 min)

  • Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

  • Reference calls

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.
